claimText: An aircraft may be cleared to a level previously occupied by another aircraft after the latter has reported vacating it, except when severe turbulence is known to exist, the higher aircraft is effecting a cruise climb, or the difference in aircraft performance is such that less than the applicable separation minimum may result.
rationale: Permits re-use of a level after vacating, subject to specific safety exceptions.
